source_assessment.identity_readiness: Ready. HABS and current NPS sources explicitly identify the Lee Mangus/Manges cabin as the present Jenny Lake Ranger Station.
source_assessment.geometry_readiness: Ready after full-resolution HABS extraction. Four measured sheets document plan, all elevations, sections, roof framing, dimensions, openings, materials, and porch details.
source_assessment.placement_readiness: Ready. terrain/public/buildings.json contains one exact named Jenny Lake Ranger Station footprint; the similarly named Manges Cabin and Jenny Lake Visitor Center are explicit exclusions.
source_assessment.projection_readiness: Blocked until at least two useful same-building photographic exterior elevations have item-level creator and rights metadata. HABS drawings may establish geometry but do not satisfy the photographic surface-reference gate.

required_before_geometry: Download only the HABS WY-108 measured sheets and data page required for plan, elevations, section, roof framing, and porch extraction.
Prefer the smallest derivative that keeps dimensions legible; do not bulk-download the collection.
Record retrieval date, final URL, byte count, sheet number, and SHA-256 for every acquired artifact.
Confirm drawing scale, north arrow, wall envelope, ridge height, porch geometry, and opening dimensions are legible before extraction.
Hash terrain/public/buildings.json and persist the exact Jenny Lake Ranger Station record.
required_before_projection: Resolve item-level authorship and rights for every selected photographic image.
Confirm each image depicts the relocated Lee Mangus/Manges cabin serving as Jenny Lake Ranger Station.
Reject photographs of the Crandall Studio visitor center, James/Jimmy Manges Cabin, and Jackson Lake Ranger Station.
Require at least two useful photographic exterior elevations before invoking an image tool.
Use HABS elevations to register geometry and openings; do not treat drawing hatching or text as facade texture.
